name: baidu-token-plan-cn-multi
description: Baidu Qianfan Token Plan 个人版 with multiple API keys for load distribution. Each account gets its own group. Note: each Baidu account is limited to one Token Plan subscription.
keyInstructions: Subscribe to Baidu Token Plan 个人版 at https://cloud.baidu.com/product/codingplan.html and get dedicated API keys at https://console.bce.baidu.com/qianfan/resource/token-plan. For each account, provide the key when prompted. Keys are stored separately in VS Code's keystore.
